copy.help.install:
The online calculator remains available without registration. To receive the official standalone edition, apply for partnership and confirm your email. Your company name and website can be supplied later; email confirmation alone does not mean that an installation URL has been checked.

When the archive email arrives, save the ZIP and use the password from that email to extract it. Use an extraction tool tested with the release's AES-256 ZIP format; if your built-in tool cannot open it, contact support. Do not publish the archive password. Open the extracted HTML to check the calculator, then upload the HTML to your website's hosting and link to its HTTPS page. Keep the Nomad360 branding, contacts and required notices unchanged. Tell us the page URL after publication so that we can check the installation. A downloaded edition does not update automatically. PDF and Excel export save calculation results; they do not install the calculator or replace a restorable draft.
